backwalk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D side-view fighting-game sprite sheet of Zhongli from Genshin Impact. Reference image is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND COSTUME only. Same tall adult male, amber eyes, dark brown hair with amber tips, white shoulder accents, fitted brown/black/gold long coat, black gloves, long black trousers, brown/gold boots. Exactly SIX distinct full-body poses in a clean 3 columns by 2 rows grid, left-to-right then top-to-bottom. All facing RIGHT. Each cell has ample empty margin and same camera/body scale: standing height 390px in 512px cell, eight-head adult anatomy; don't shrink character when extending limbs/weapons. Frame complete hair, feet, hands, coat tails and weapons. Flat controlled cel shading, crisp brown-black hairline silhouette, neutral lighting, genuine transparent background. No background, floor, shadow, glow, captions, cell borders, duplication or extra characters. Preserve constant skull, torso, thigh and shin lengths; natural bent/foreshortened joints. Gameplay pose readability, not fashion illustration.
Reference is one standing mother sprite, not desired pose. Copy adult anatomy exactly. Absolutely no colored haze/glow/rim lighting. Outside body zero alpha. Spear has one pointed goldhead at forwardend and a plain metalbutt at otherend, never doublebladed. For wide weapon poses each cell width accommodates fullbody and fullspear, don't overlap cells. Same flat illustrative cel style as mother.
ACTION '后退': Empty hands, defensive BACKWARD gait while facing right: six distinct chronological poses righttoe behindcontact, weighttransfer backright, leftleg passes backwards, lefttoe behindcontact, weighttransfer backleft, rightleg passes backwards. Alternating contact and crossing legs, slight defensive rearlean, guarded hands. Clearly backward steps, not forward poses.
